name: cr701_20e_visibility_ponder_look_top_three
why: CR 701.20e / 701.20d: Ponder opens a look window for its caster alone on each of the top three cards; each ends as the card is put back (a reordered card stops being looked at) (step 1 T1 reveal windows, --trace-visibility)
expect_order: Player A looks at the top 3 card\(s\) of their library
^VISIBILITY: open look Lightning Bolt in library of A at 0 to A \(until resolution end\)
^VISIBILITY: open look Brainstorm in library of A at 1 to A
^VISIBILITY: open look Force of Will in library of A at 2 to A
^VISIBILITY: close look Force of Will in library of A at 2 to A \(zone change\)
^VISIBILITY: close look Lightning Bolt in library of A at 1 to A \(zone change\)
^VISIBILITY: close look Brainstorm in library of A at 2 to A \(zone change\)
